features.title: Pick an element and add it to the draft
features.summary: Pick an element in DSH, write a bounded note, and insert a source-linked block into the composer draft without sending it.
failureModes: No Session is open, so the composer action refuses to start a pick.
The picker cannot read the element because it sits under a private or form field, so it refuses that pick.
The Host store is unavailable, so saving reports an error and the draft is untouched.
The source map for a bundle is missing, so the annotation keeps its selector and reports no source.
reach: expect textbox "Describe what you want to build, / commands, @ files or sessions"
expect textbox "What is wrong or what should change?"
fill textbox "What is wrong or what should change?" "the tab strip overlaps the sidebar"

verification.testName: creates a pending annotation with a stable id
refuses to resolve a stale revision
captures a bounded descriptor
refuses an input value
prints selector, page, source and note

features.title: Resolve an element to its source
features.summary: Map a captured CSS class or exact visible text to a file and line inside an owned plugin bundle through its client source map.
failureModes: The bundle was built without a source map, so the match is absent and the annotation keeps its selector only.
The map is larger than the parse cap, so it is skipped rather than blocking the Host.
The class hash appears in no built bundle, so no match is returned instead of guessing.

verification.testName: maps a class hash to its module source
falls back to text in the original source
returns no match rather than guessing

features.title: Intake annotations from the browser extension
features.summary: Pair a pinned-origin browser extension through a two-minute single-use window, then accept its annotations over a token-authenticated loopback route and keep them unassigned until the user picks a thread.
failureModes: Pairing is refused when the window is closed, has expired, or the origin is not the pinned extension origin.
A wrong token, a non-extension origin or a non-loopback peer is refused before any parse.
A body over the size cap is refused with 413.
An unassigned annotation is never attached to a Session without the user choosing one.

externalDependencies.boundary: Only the page's own script can capture an element on a site DSH does not own, so the extension is the only capture path for those pages.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: The Host ingest route is exercised directly over loopback HTTP with a valid token, a wrong token, a foreign origin and an oversize body, without loading the extension.

verification.testName: accepts a valid annotation
rejects a wrong token
rejects a non-extension origin
ingests unattached extension feedback and attaches it to a chosen Session
derives the pinned id from the committed manifest key
refuses before the window is armed
hands the token over once while the window is open
answers the extension preflight with CORS headers

features.title: Annotate an HTML preview
features.summary: Open a workspace HTML file in a sandboxed, instrumented preview and annotate an element inside it with the file as its source.
failureModes: A path outside the working directory, a non-HTML file, a missing file or one over 2 MB is refused with the reason.
The preview's own scripts are stripped and the frame is sandboxed without allow-same-origin, so page code cannot reach DSH.
The inspector never reports an element for a private subtree or a form control.

verification.testName: removes the page scripts and inline handlers
refuses a path outside the root

features.title: Pick on any page in a DSH-owned Chrome
features.summary: Launch a Chrome profile with a loopback debugging port, open a configured start URL, and inject the same bounded picker over the DevTools protocol — on the focused tab by default, or on a listed tab.

configuration.constraints: Absolute path to a Chrome or Chromium executable; empty auto-detects the platform install.
Pick on the focused tab instead of listing tabs; false restores the per-tab list.
Page the launched browser opens; empty opens a blank tab.

failureModes: No Chrome or Chromium is found, so the panel says so and points at the setting instead of guessing.
Chrome never opens its debugging port in time, so the launch fails with that reason.
A pick that is never answered times out and arms nothing afterwards.
A tab that disappeared between listing and picking is reported, not silently retried.

externalDependencies.boundary: The picker runs inside a real Chrome; the protocol is unauthenticated loopback, so only the DSH-owned profile is launched.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: The integration test launches headless Chrome, serves a fixture page and dispatches a real click, then asserts the picked selector and text.
